# What’s new in OverCue Desktop 2.2.3 for macOS

- Fixes a misleading library warning on matching rekordbox USB exports with duplicate track entries.
- Repairs missing OneLibrary stem bindings for existing complete stems, including manual imports, without regenerating their audio. To repair stems marked as missing, select only those tracks and choose Generate & Package on USB in Automatic mode. Regenerate explicitly replaces stems, including manual imports.
- Adds separation-server setup guidance and a Copy instructions for AI coding agents button in Settings.
- Adds copied instructions for preparing USB stems with an AI coding agent, starting with hardware checks and a compatible model for Vocals, Drums and Harmonics / Other.
- Lets coding agents use OverCue’s built-in decoder, validator and packager with independently generated stems. Packaging preserves existing stem entries and original rekordbox files.
